build_resnet18_fpga: build a ResNet-18 FPGA model using the resnet18 function with an ext, context, program, and queue
build_resnet50_fpga: build a ResNet-50 FPGA model using the resnet50 function with Bottleneck blocks and an ext handle
create_sequential_module: create a Sequential container to chain multiple FPGA modules together for forward pass execution
fuse_batch_norm: fuse a PyTorch Conv2d and BatchNorm2d layer into combined weights and biases using fuse_bn
transfer_fused_params: transfer fused batch norm parameters from a PyTorch ResNet to an FPGA ResNet using fuse_resnet_params
